sourceClaims.claim: Document specimens establish 55px body, 38px file visual, 12px radius and default/hover/error paint
width is container-driven rather than a public specimen-width enum
the filename and independent native actions own activation; the row root is inert

Composer and File Upload compose File Row at a preferred 229px width matching current Comment Feed, shrinking in narrow containers without growing into spare space; existing source-derived file SVGs and accessible supporting metadata color are reused.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: Documents.svg is traced directly for geometry and paint rather than relying on prior source tests
evidence.structural-contract: pass: all 18 initial File Row roots and 24 inert diagnostic rows are classified; dynamic selection/removal runs the shared occurrence guard with explicit expected row IDs
evidence.runtime-browser: not-applicable: File Row has no controller or root activation; native links and buttons own their behavior
evidence.accessibility: pass: root stays inert, decorative file visuals are hidden and filename/action targets retain meaningful native names
evidence.focused-visual: pass: attachment-composition browser checks compare 229x55 cards, 38px visuals, 12px radius and metadata paint with Comment Feed; focused desktop and 220px attachment crops are inspected
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: Data Workspace File Upload updates the classified File Row filename and type icon, then restores the generic empty placeholder on removal; Composer Data Workspace retains its attachment and submit flow
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long localized/unbroken attachment names ellipsize inside 220px cards at 200-percent root text; visuals and existing actions remain contained; three selected files wrap without growing

staticVisual: pass: forced hover and error fixtures are retained only as static source comparisons
realInteractionVisual: pass: locator.hover() on a linked File Row produces the source-backed background paint
runtimeBehavior: not-applicable: File Row delegates navigation and actions to nested native Link/Button elements

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: 2026-09-09 affected desktop and narrow attachment crops inspected against Comments/Document SVG crops; focus-visible, keyboard removal and unchanged component state flows exercised in focused browser coverage

knownLimitations: upload progress, preview and whole-row activation are not public File Row behavior
File Upload Data Workspace preserves its existing first-file summary and selection count; additional files are shown individually by the showcase selection fixtures, not by that summary consumer.

dynamicOccurrences.scope: Showcase File Upload selections outside Data Workspace; zero at initial load. IDs stay with remaining rows after removal and reset on replacement selection.
dynamicOccurrences.guard: The focused browser test extends the static manifest with explicit expected selected IDs, runs the shared guard after selection and removal, and retains the full static occurrence set.
